{{Quote|Excuse me, I beg your pardon. Maybe you know my brother's boy; he's a member of the Imperial Military. He must be twenty-four, twenty-five years old by now; he loves the service, great little guy.|Saun Dann, breaking up a potential fight between an Imperial technician and Mallatobuck|<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]] once claimed to have a '''nephew''' while trying to break up a potential fight between an [[Unidentified Imperial technician|Imperial technician]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]]. According to Dann, the nephew was his [[Saun Dann's brother|brother's]] son, [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] about twenty-four or twenty-five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], at which point he was in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special" />
